```{r}
#| label: import-data

#### practice level orlistat data
```

```{r}
#| label: tirzepatide_clean
#| include: false
df_tirzepatide_practice <- df_tirzepatide_practice %>%
  mutate(
    strength = gsub("[^0-9/.]", "", bnf_name),
    strength = gsub("2.4", "", strength),
    strength = gsub("/", "mg / ", strength),
    strength = glue("{strength}ml")
  ) |>
  select(-sha, -pct)
```

```{r}
#| label: orlistat_clean
#| include: false
df_orlistat_practice <- df_orlistat_practice |>
  mutate(
    strength = gsub("\\D", "", bnf_name),
    strength = glue("{strength}mg")
  ) |>
  select(-sha, -pct)
```


```{r}
#| label: filter_practices
#| include: false

### join practice open dates to practice list size by code / practice
df_included_practices <- df_practice_open_info |>
  inner_join(df_practice_list_size, by = join_by(code == practice)) |>
  ## create closed status by month
  ## close date is after end of month, join date is before month, leave_provider_date is after end of month)
  mutate(
    month_status = case_when(
      !is.na(close_date) & close_date <= rollforward(month) ~ "closed",
      (!is.na(join_provider_date) & join_provider_date >= month) ~ "not opened",
      !is.na(leave_provider_date) &
        (leave_provider_date <= rollforward(month)) ~ "left provider",
      .default = "open"
    )
  ) |>
  # exclude unopen, dormat and pratcices with list_size < 1000
  filter(
    month_status == "open",
    status_code_label != "Dormant",
    total_list_size >= 1000
  ) |>
  select(code, month, total_list_size, ccg_id) |>
  left_join(
    df_ccgs |> select(code, regional_team_id, stp_id),
    by = join_by(ccg_id == code)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: combine_data_sets
#| include: false

combine_data <- function(drug) {
  df <- get(glue("df_{drug}_practice"))

  df_strength <- df |>
    distinct(strength)

  df_included_practices <- df_included_practices |>
    crossing(df_strength)

  ### add chemical name from df_chemical_names_
  df2 <- df |>
    inner_join(
      get(glue("df_chemical_names_{drug}")),
      by = join_by(bnf_code == presentation_code)
    )
  ### warn if rows added or removed
  if (nrow(df2) != nrow(df)) {
    print(glue("df mismatch bnf: df {nrow(df)}, df2 {nrow(df2)}"))
  }

  df2 <- df2
  ### add practice info from df_included_practices
  df3 <- df2 |>
    right_join(
      df_included_practices,
      by = join_by(month, strength, practice == code)
    ) %>%
    select(-bnf_name)

  df3 |>
    fill(c(regional_team, stp), .direction = "downup", .by = practice) |>
    fill(chemical, .direction = "downup") |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      regional_team = case_when(
        is.na(regional_team) ~ regional_team_id,
        .default = regional_team
      ),
      stp = case_when(is.na(stp) ~ stp_id, .default = stp),
      items = replace_na(items, 0)
    ) |>
    select(-bnf_code, -ccg_id, -regional_team_id)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: icb-level
#| include: false

icb_level_data <- function(drug, strength = FALSE) {
  ## aggregate to stp level
  if (strength == FALSE) {
    df <- combine_data(drug) |>
      summarise(
        item = sum(items, na.rm = T),
        total_list_size = sum(total_list_size, na.rm = T),
        .by = c(stp, regional_team, month)
      )
  }
  ## aggregate to stp level and strength
  if (strength == TRUE) {
    df <- combine_data(drug) |>
      summarise(
        item = sum(items, na.rm = T),
        total_list_size = sum(total_list_size, na.rm = T),
        .by = c(stp, regional_team, month, strength)
      )
  }

  df
}

icb_level_data("orlistat")
icb_level_data("orlistat", T)
icb_level_data("tirzepatide")
```

```{r}
#| label: all-england
#| include: false

england_level_data <- function(drug, strength = FALSE) {
  ## aggregate to stp level
  if (strength == FALSE) {
    df <- combine_data(drug) |>
      summarise(
        item = sum(items, na.rm = T),
        total_list_size = sum(total_list_size, na.rm = T),
        .by = c(month)
      )
  }
  ## aggregate to stp level and strength
  if (strength == TRUE) {
    df <- combine_data(drug) |>
      summarise(
        item = sum(items, na.rm = T),
        total_list_size = sum(total_list_size, na.rm = T),
        .by = c(month, strength)
      )
  }

  df
}


df_orlistat <- england_level_data("orlistat")
df_tirzepatide <- england_level_data("tirzepatide", T)
```
